persona_egma_provided_is_active.name: persona_egma_provided_is_active
persona_egma_provided_is_active.value: "persona"."organization_id" is not null or "persona"."archived_at" is null

agent_monitoring_key_needs_platform.name: agent_monitoring_key_needs_platform
agent_monitoring_key_needs_platform.value: "agent"."monitoring_api_key" is null or "agent"."agent_platform" is not null

agent_pull_needs_binding.name: agent_pull_needs_binding
agent_pull_needs_binding.value: "agent"."pull_production_calls" = false or ("agent"."agent_platform" is not null and "agent"."platform_agent_id" is not null and "agent"."monitoring_api_key" is not null)

monitoring_state_scan_agrees.name: monitoring_state_scan_agrees
monitoring_state_scan_agrees.value: ("monitoring_state"."scan_kind" is null and "monitoring_state"."scan_from" is null and "monitoring_state"."scan_through" is null and "monitoring_state"."pagination_key" is null) or ("monitoring_state"."scan_kind" is not null and "monitoring_state"."scan_from" is not null and "monitoring_state"."scan_through" is not null)

project_grader_scope_is_closed_object.name: project_grader_scope_is_closed_object
project_grader_scope_is_closed_object.value:
jsonb_typeof("project_grader"."scope") is not distinct from 'object'
        and ("project_grader"."scope" - array['simulations', 'production']::text[])
          is not distinct from '{}'::jsonb
        and "project_grader"."scope" ?& array['simulations', 'production']::text[]
        and jsonb_typeof("project_grader"."scope"->'simulations') is not distinct from 'array'
        and (
          "project_grader"."scope"->'production' = 'null'::jsonb
          or jsonb_typeof("project_grader"."scope"->'production') is not distinct from 'object'
        )

run_counts_written_together.name: run_counts_written_together
run_counts_written_together.value:
(("run"."completed_count" is null) = ("run"."failed_count" is null))
        and (("run"."failed_count" is null) = ("run"."canceled_count" is null))
        and (("run"."canceled_count" is null) = ("run"."finished_at" is null))

run_started_when_left_pending.name: run_started_when_left_pending
run_started_when_left_pending.value:
case
        when "run"."status" = 'pending' then "run"."started_at" is null
        when "run"."status" in ('running', 'completed') then "run"."started_at" is not null
        else true
      end

run_event_run_shape.name: run_event_run_shape
run_event_run_shape.value:
"run_event"."kind" <> 'run'
        or ("run_event"."simulation_id" is null
          and "run_event"."reason" is null
          and "run_event"."status" in ('pending', 'running', 'completed', 'canceled'))

run_event_simulation_shape.name: run_event_simulation_shape
run_event_simulation_shape.value:
"run_event"."kind" <> 'simulation'
        or ("run_event"."simulation_id" is not null
          and "run_event"."status" in ('queued', 'claimed', 'running', 'completed', 'failed', 'canceled'))

run_event_reason_agrees.name: run_event_reason_agrees
run_event_reason_agrees.value:
"run_event"."reason" is null
        or ("run_event"."status" = 'completed' and "run_event"."reason" in ('persona_concluded', 'agent_ended', 'limit_reached'))
        or ("run_event"."status" = 'failed' and "run_event"."reason" in ('agent_never_joined', 'not_answered', 'capacity', 'simulator_error', 'orphaned', 'dispatch_failed'))

simulation_ending_reason_agrees.name: simulation_ending_reason_agrees
simulation_ending_reason_agrees.value:
case "simulation"."status"
        when 'completed' then "simulation"."ending_reason" in ('persona_concluded', 'agent_ended', 'limit_reached')
        when 'failed' then "simulation"."ending_reason" in ('agent_never_joined', 'not_answered', 'capacity', 'simulator_error', 'orphaned', 'dispatch_failed')
        else "simulation"."ending_reason" is null
      end

simulation_claim_columns_agree.name: simulation_claim_columns_agree
simulation_claim_columns_agree.value:
(("simulation"."claimed_at" is null) = ("simulation"."claimed_by" is null))
        and (("simulation"."claimed_at" is null) = ("simulation"."heartbeat_at" is null))

simulation_queued_shape.name: simulation_queued_shape
simulation_queued_shape.value:
"simulation"."status" <> 'queued'
        or ("simulation"."claimed_at" is null and "simulation"."started_at" is null
          and "simulation"."ended_at" is null and "simulation"."cancel_requested_at" is null)

simulation_claimed_shape.name: simulation_claimed_shape
simulation_claimed_shape.value:
"simulation"."status" <> 'claimed'
        or ("simulation"."claimed_at" is not null and "simulation"."started_at" is null
          and "simulation"."ended_at" is null)

simulation_running_shape.name: simulation_running_shape
simulation_running_shape.value:
"simulation"."status" <> 'running'
        or ("simulation"."claimed_at" is not null and "simulation"."started_at" is not null
          and "simulation"."ended_at" is null)

simulation_completed_shape.name: simulation_completed_shape
simulation_completed_shape.value:
"simulation"."status" <> 'completed'
        or ("simulation"."started_at" is not null and "simulation"."ended_at" is not null)

simulation_canceled_shape.name: simulation_canceled_shape
simulation_canceled_shape.value:
"simulation"."status" <> 'canceled'
        or ("simulation"."ended_at" is not null and "simulation"."cancel_requested_at" is not null)

simulation_report_only_when_ended.name: simulation_report_only_when_ended
simulation_report_only_when_ended.value:
"simulation"."ended_at" is not null
        or "simulation"."recording_reference" is null

simulation_recording_origin_agrees.name: simulation_recording_origin_agrees
simulation_recording_origin_agrees.value:
"simulation"."recording_started_at" is null
        or ("simulation"."ended_at" is not null
          and "simulation"."modality" = 'voice'
          and "simulation"."recording_reference" is not null)

simulation_summary_facts_only_when_ended.name: simulation_summary_facts_only_when_ended
simulation_summary_facts_only_when_ended.value:
"simulation"."ended_at" is not null
        or ("simulation"."turn_count" is null and "simulation"."provider_reference" is null)

simulation_mock_tool_coverage_only_when_.name: simulation_mock_tool_coverage_only_when_ended
simulation_mock_tool_coverage_only_when_.value: "simulation"."ended_at" is not null or "simulation"."mock_tool_coverage" is null

grading_job_source_names_its_control_rec.name: grading_job_source_names_its_control_record
grading_job_source_names_its_control_rec.value:
case "grading_job"."source"
        when 'simulation' then "grading_job"."simulation_id" is not null and "grading_job"."run_id" is not null
        when 'production' then "grading_job"."simulation_id" is null and "grading_job"."run_id" is null
        else false
      end

grading_job_claim_columns_agree.name: grading_job_claim_columns_agree
grading_job_claim_columns_agree.value:
(("grading_job"."claimed_at" is null) = ("grading_job"."claimed_by" is null))
        and (("grading_job"."claimed_at" is null) = ("grading_job"."heartbeat_at" is null))

grading_job_pending_shape.name: grading_job_pending_shape
grading_job_pending_shape.value:
"grading_job"."status" <> 'pending'
        or ("grading_job"."claimed_at" is null and "grading_job"."finished_at" is null)

grading_job_claimed_shape.name: grading_job_claimed_shape
grading_job_claimed_shape.value:
"grading_job"."status" <> 'claimed'
        or ("grading_job"."claimed_at" is not null and "grading_job"."finished_at" is null)
